name: Publish fully synced main
command:
set -e
server_path="$("$HOME/.nix-profile/bin/nix" --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' path-info .#server)"
T3CODE_HOME="$(mktemp -d /tmp/t3code-latest-smoke-XXXXXX)" "$server_path/bin/t3" --help > /tmp/t3code-latest-smoke-help.txt
git fetch upstream main
git merge-base --is-ancestor upstream/main HEAD
test "$(git rev-list --count --merges upstream/main..HEAD)" = 0
git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/main:98f356871bc1c369a100f3ef22db3fd256321cfc origin HEAD:main
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
printf 'Missing upstream commits on origin/main: '
git rev-list --count origin/main..upstream/main
printf 'Fork merge commits: '
git rev-list --count --merges upstream/main..origin/main
git status --short --branch
git log -1 --oneline
